sourceTitle: A Theodicy, or, Vindication of the Divine Glory
description: "A Theodicy, or, Vindication of the Divine Glory" by Albert Taylor Bledsoe is a philosophical and theological treatise written in the mid-19th century. The work explores the profound problem of evil in relation to a perfect divine being, striving to reconcile the existence of moral and natural evils with God's holiness and goodness.
